svg.title: v17pro main with bidirectional cross-attention
svg.desc: Two directional attention currents enter the respective Image and Audio Value layers. The recurrent Index still integrates the private spiking pathways.
svg.text: 13 cue layouts · C clean | P known gaps | N local noise | A absent
Rose paths carry directional attention currents. Purple paths carry modality cues and private spikes. Rᵢ and Rₐ control repair.
